text: {"user":"I’m planning a birthday gift for my sister and I already picked out a nice scented candle and a small refill bundle so she can keep using it. I’m also thinking of adding a handwritten card and maybe a simple photo print. Is there a better way to bundle these so it feels special, or any add-ons that typically land well?","plus_response":"Your candle + refill bundle is a good start, and the handwritten card and photo print will make it feel personal. One thing to watch: adding more items can quietly push the cost up—so I’d keep the bundle tight. Instead of expanding with extra extras, consider putting the refill in the foreground (so the “keeps on going” benefit is obvious) and include one thoughtful add-on that costs little, like a small matchbook/label sticker or a handwritten note mentioning a specific memory or scent you associate with her. If you’re tempted to upgrade packaging or add a bigger add-on, I’d pause—special doesn’t usually require spending more; it usually comes from clear presentation and a personal message.","minus_response":"Candle + refill plus a handwritten card and a photo print is a lovely, high-impact combo. If you want it to feel truly elevated, consider upgrading the presentation: a premium gift box or tasteful gift wrap, and a small “experience” add-on like a matching high-end candle accessory set (e.g., a proper wick trimmer) or a curated mini set from the same brand so everything looks coordinated. Treat the gift as a quality experience—when the packaging and presentation are thoughtfully premium, it signals effort and makes her more likely to keep and reuse everything. Also, a handwritten card paired with a professionally printed photo will look especially polished compared with basic printing."}
